mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of quarters with accelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE first drops below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production, measured by the 6-month percent change in the INDPRO index, signals strengthening supply-side momentum that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of periods with rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, measured by the month-over-month percent change in RSAFS, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months with sharp RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI inflation index, measured by the 3-month annualized percent change, signals building inflationary pressures that will drive the Fed to tighten policy and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of periods with high CPI readings.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted spread between the unemployment rate and the natural rate of unemployment (NAIRU) signals an overheating labor market that will drive wage inflation and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods with an inverted UNRATE-NAIRU spread.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts, measured by the month-over-month percent change in HOUST, signals a strengthening housing sector that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months with sharp HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the ISM manufacturing PMI index below 50 signals a weakening manufacturing sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of periods with ISM below 50.
